title: Greenpro Capital Corp. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-21
summary: Greenpro Capital Corp. (GRNQ), a Nevada-based company listed on NASDAQ Capital Market, consummated the acquisition of a 0.99% minority interest (10 ordinary shares) in Greenophene Technologies Limited, a British Virgin Islands company, for consideration of 800,000 restricted shares of common stock valued at $1.50 per share ($1.2 million aggregate value). The transaction, originally agreed on November 18, 2025, closed on April 16, 2026, with all conditions satisfied.
key_points: Greenpro Capital Corp. acquired 0.99% minority stake (10 shares) in Greenophene Technologies Limited on April 16, 2026.
Purchase consideration: 800,000 restricted shares of GRNQ common stock at $1.50 per share ($1,200,000 total).
Post-closing shares outstanding: 17,925,813; seller holds approximately 4.5% of company after receiving shares.
The issuance relied on Rule 506 of Regulation D exemption from securities registration.
Acquisition Agreement signed November 18, 2025; original 8-K filed November 20, 2025.
